claim: A portable 16-profile NativeStack2604 Terminal fragment carries explicit Microsoft-derived profile identities and the maintained bell/truecolor policy; source/fixture checks pass, while host deployment and session continuity remain pending.
limitations: Repository/source checks only: no Windows Terminal deployment, UI, sound-playback or session-continuity acceptance was performed.
Source transformations remove private bindings; owner-supplied command-center, co-op and account-pool launchers are deployment prerequisites, not accepted implementations.
Librarium cwd and clone/vault binding are DEFERRED to P1-CLI; its profile remains hidden. Librarium course is a distinct project.
Operations and Local Chat depend on the installed nativestack CLI; four lane launcher/prompt files must be staged by their owner. No prompt body is authored here.
The old independent HTTP omniroute-fw on 20129 has no established 2604 equivalent. Its references are DEFERRED to Phase 3; WebSocket 21129 is not a replacement.

The broader 174-test regression retained one installed-client currency failure: Claude 2.1.291 exposes auth_storage_failure, absent from the unchanged notification decision table. 173 tests passed; no test or setting was changed to conceal it.

The command-center exact-head read at b216f9d7884d4d8519743b9e1c8f4f3c53181513 returned ACK_AFTER with two P2 and four P3 findings. Repair micro-check and operator host apply/read-back remain pending; a source review is not deployment acceptance.
transformations: Keep the NativeStack fragment folder and all nine existing 2604 profile names; add the documented explicit GUID identities.
Use default WSL user and portable home-relative project paths; omit private fixed session identifiers and authentication assignments without recording their values.
Ordinary client resumes use native pickers; three special roles delegate to owner-supplied private launchers.
Add source-defined Operations and Local Chat; carry a hidden Librarium profile with its cwd contract deferred.

Carry four source-defined lane profiles in a separate commit, repointing distribution/name/project paths to 2604; retain the original launcher/prompt basenames. Prompt bodies and any 20129 HTTP replacement are not supplied.
Preserve AI audible+taskbar bells/quiet sound, Claude COLORTERM=truecolor, static taskbar bells and application-driven AI titles.

The token lane intentionally changes from the source lane fragment's explicit identity to the canonical derived identity. Deploy hides obsolete NativeStack-source 2604 identities absent from the canonical set, preserving canonical, other-source and old NativeStack profiles.

Deliberately omit the nine source tabTitle values for the profile-name initial-title fallback, and omit closeOnExit graceful for Terminal's automatic default, which is graceful for Terminal-launched processes. Four lane titles remain explicit. Default/title fallback behavior is qualified by preserved user, GUID-specific and profiles.defaults overrides.

Apply checks all visible launcher, prompt, native CLI and project-directory dependencies before copying. Preserve exact settings bytes when the effective default and obsolete-profile overrides already match; name or GUID defaults are accepted, without bypassing duplicate hiding.

Keep the original private fragment and its backup outside every AI/co-op copy/read operation: original backup and restoration are human-owned. The automatic recipe handles settings and the public replacement only; absence markers never read private contents.
